export_evidence: ImportKey page for 'CERATIZIT INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED' (https://importkey.com/countries/india/ceratizit-india-private-limited) shows 'Total Shipments 99722 Records detected', 'Trading Partners 114', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-28' and a 'Buyers' block listing e.g. '7035 CERATIZIT BALZHEIM GMBH & CO.KG ... CERATIZIT INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED, CARL-OTTO-WEG 21 88481 BALZHEIM-UNTERBALZHEIM DEUTSCHLAND,GERMANY' — i.e. the Indian entity appears as shipper to German group buyers. However the visible row-level records on the free view are all IMPORT rows into India (e.g. '2026-02-28 CERATIZIT INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED ... TUNGSTEN CARBIDE INSERT ... KOLKATA ACC INCCU4, India ... SHANGHAI, CHINA 82090010 1106990'); no dated export row with destination + HS + B/L number was readable. Counter check: page claims 99,722 shipments, but only 5 row-level records were visible and all were imports.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report India sales split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403, eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, volza.com returned HTTP 403, and web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) for 'Ceratizit India GST turnover GeM tender' and '"CERATIZIT INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED" turnover financials'.
note: Legal entity exists and is active in customs data: address '5TH FLOOR, KIRTI MAHAL, 19, RAJENDRA PLACE' (New Delhi), latest customs activity 2026-02-28, 70 port lanes, top ports MUNICH 8052 / KOLKATA ACC 4522 / BANGALORE ACC 2584. The observed trade flow is predominantly INBOUND: carbide inserts, screws, clamping parts from Shanghai, Munich, Reutte, Gabrovo into Kolkata/Bangalore ACC — consistent with a sales subsidiary of the Austrian CERATIZIT group rather than an Indian exporter. Outbound links to CERATIZIT BALZHEIM / BESIGHEIM (Germany) are visible only as aggregated buyer-counterparties, not as dated export B/L rows, so export is recorded as declared_only, not confirmed. Declared HS 820320 (files/pliers) does not match the observed trade: visible records are HS 82090010 (tungsten carbide inserts), 73181500 (screws/bolts) — actual code should be corrected to 820900/731815 family; per project rules this is not a rejection ground. No revenue or export-volume figures are public in the sources reachable — left null, not estimated. No evidence of domestic Indian supply (no GST band, no tender/contract record found) — 'следов поставок не найдено' for the domestic market within the sources checked; this is a data-access limitation, not proof of absence.
